name: XTREME
description: Cross-lingual Transfer Evaluation of Multilingual Encoders tests transfer learning from English to 40 typologically diverse languages across 9 tasks: sentence pair classification (XNLI, PAWS-X), structured prediction (POS tagging, NER), QA (XQuAD, MLQA, TyDi QA), and sentence retrieval (BUCC, Tatoeba). Designed to evaluate how well multilingual models generalize across linguistic families.
typical_sota_score: ~80–85% average (best multilingual models like XLM-R Large, mT5-XL)
reputation: Foundational multilingual benchmark; published at ICML 2020 by Google Research; historically important for mBERT, XLM-R, mT5 development; widely cited in multilingual NLP papers
notes: Covers 40 languages including many low-resource varieties. Static (no updates since 2021 for XTREME-R). Largely superseded for generative LLMs by Global-MMLU, Belebele, and MGSM. Still relevant for encoder-based multilingual models. XTREME-R (2021) was an extended revision. Published at ICML 2020.
